generated ComputeDriver/CredentialDriver/SupervisorMiddleware/HttpResponsePreReturn/GatewayInterceptor stubs are checked against the pinned proto source by task compat:proto, remote driver capability probes use typed clients, optional CredentialDriver ListCredentials is capability-probed with bounded calls and handle-only response validation, configured SupervisorMiddleware registrations call Describe with manifest/binding validation at gateway startup and ValidateConfig for selected policy configs, configured GatewayInterceptor registrations call Describe, modify_operation RFC 6902 patches and validate for CreateSandbox before durable/backend side effects, and post_commit callbacks after commit, and the remote ComputeDriver adapter dispatches Validate/Create/Start/Stop/Delete plus WatchSandboxes platform-event bridging through generated clients;
